implement.summary: Defects on BASE_SHA f250acd7 (VERIFIED): (a) apps/mobile/src/data/api.ts createAnalysisPermitClient().release() (base ~L176-190) accepted ANY 2xx as a finalize acknowledgement — on base there was no acknowledgesRelease() at all, and the r4 candidate's version returned true whenever `body.permit === undefined` — so `{}`, `{ok:true}`, `{permit:{}}`, `{permit:{status:'finalized'}}` (no id), a 200 error envelope and a 202 `{}` were recorded as state 'released' while the server permit stayed 'reserved' (reservation leaked). (b) request() (base ~L200-235) mapped a 4xx with a non-JSON / non-envelope body to ApiError(status,'unknown'); runJournal failure() (src/analysis/runJournal.ts) and sync isPermanentSyncFailure() (src/data/sync.ts) treat any 4xx other than 401/408/429 as terminal, so a captive-portal 403 HTML / gateway 404 / proxy 400 text on finalize made the attempt 'terminal'/'release_rejected' (server permit still reserved, never retried), on the recovery reserve made it 'terminal'/'reservation_rejected' though the server never saw the request, and on sync burned an outbox attempt. Fix (commit ddf33b22, all in apps/mobile/src/data/api.ts, wired into the shipping request()/permit client path): a finalize acknowledgement must be the route's `{permit,access}` view naming THIS permit id with a settled (non-'reserved') status and the REQUESTED outcome — anything else is ApiError(502,'access.permit_release_unconfirmed'); a 4xx without a `{error:{code}}` envelope (401/408/429 excepted) is ApiError(502,'network.invalid_response') so it is retried under the same permit id / reservation key / outbox row on the next launch, while a coded envelope keeps its status+code as the verdict.
